essence: The teacher must utter the three vyāhṛtis and then make the disciple hear the Sāvitrī.
Sāvitrī, as the presiding deity, is employed for the purpose of liberation.
One should say the word bhargaḥ at the end of the pada of devasya and then say dhīmahi.
After uttering the praṇava again, the teacher should explain the meaning of the Sāvitrī.
The teacher should make the disciple hear the Gāyatrī.
